title: Getting Started
description: One shapefile on the server, cut into vector tiles and drawn by the browser, with the map's own zoom and extent limits.

title: Map Navigation
description: Zoom, scale, centre, rotation and pitch set from code, an overview map that turns with the map, and the globe.

title: Vector Tiles or Raster Tiles
description: One style.json served two ways, side by side: vector tiles the browser draws, or raster tiles the server draws from the same document.

title: Basemaps
description: ThinkGeo Maps, OpenFreeMap or any style URL as a vector basemap; ThinkGeo Cloud or OpenStreetMap as raster tiles.

title: WFS
description: Parcels from a WFS 2.0 service, fetched by the server tile by tile and drawn in the browser.

title: OGC API Features
description: Places from an OGC API Features service, projected on the server and cut into tiles.

title: NOAA Weather Stations
description: Live weather station readings from NOAA, coloured by temperature.

title: NOAA Weather Warnings
description: The warnings NOAA has active right now, coloured by severity.

title: WMS and WMTS
description: A WMS layer and a WMTS layer, each requested tile by tile from its server.

title: Vector File Formats
description: Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, GPX, TAB, TinyGeo, WKB or features built in code, drawn by one style in the browser or on the server.

title: Raster File Formats
description: GeoTIFF, JPEG, MrSID, JPEG2000, ECW or anything GDAL reads, drawn on the server and warped into the map's projection.

title: Databases
description: SQLite, GeoPackage, file geodatabase, PostGIS or SQL Server tables, drawn by one style in the browser or on the server.

title: MBTiles and PMTiles
description: Vector tiles kept in an archive file on the server and handed to the browser one at a time; no tile server, no internet.

title: Custom Data Format
description: A FeatureSource of your own: one overridden method reads a CSV, and the map treats it like any shapefile.

title: Nautical Charts
description: An S-57 chart drawn with its S-52 styling on the server, and a ship under way asking the chart at every step about depth, aids and hazards.

title: Points, Lines and Polygons
description: Style and label points, lines and polygons from three shapefiles; edit the style.json and the map follows.

title: Style by Rules
description: Value, class-break, filter and boolean styling as one mechanism: an expression in the layer's paint.

title: Choropleth Map
description: The 2010 census classed with breaks taken from the data, and a legend read from the same breaks.

title: Advanced Labels
description: Six label lessons: text along a line, anchors from a column, priority, wrapping, icons that stay, vertical CJK.

title: Heatmap
description: A heatmap over point sightings, with weight, radius, intensity and colour ramp as live controls.

title: Cluster Points
description: Hundreds of points grouped in the browser into numbered circles that split as the map zooms in.

title: Multi-Column Labels
description: World capitals labelled with name and population from two columns by a concat expression.

title: Dot Density
description: Housing units as dots scattered inside each state, one per 25,000, generated once as data.

title: Hatch Styles
description: Every GeoHatchStyle drawn by AreaStyle.CreateHatchStyle and tiled across the parks as a fill pattern.

title: Migrate a Classic Layer
description: Five classic FeatureLayers drawn on the server beside the style.json FeatureLayerTranslator wrote for them, with what could not carry over.

title: Isolines
description: Scattered readings interpolated on the server and traced into isolines the browser draws, coloured and labelled by level.

title: Dynamic Rendering
description: State populations since 1900 as circles that grow with a year slider; the features travel once, only the style changes.

title: Vehicle Navigation
description: The camera follows a vehicle along a GPS route, turned to its heading and tilted, while the trail grows behind it.

title: Lane-Level Navigation
description: An OpenDRIVE HD map of Wolfsburg drawn lane by lane while the camera follows a vehicle with lane-level instructions.

title: Shape Operations
description: Buffer, union, intersect, difference, simplify, convex hull, split and snap, run on the server and animated as the parameter changes.

title: Shape Measurements
description: Area, length, centre, the shortest line to a point and a stretch along a line, measured on the server.

title: Spatial Queries
description: Draw a shape and find the parcels that contain, cross, touch, intersect or lie within a distance of it, or query the table by SQL.

title: Feature Attributes
description: Click a park and read every column its record holds, found by a point-in-polygon query.

title: Validate Topology
description: Twenty-five topology rules checked with TopologyValidator, each drawn with the shapes that break it.

title: Reproject Your Data
description: One ProjectionConverter, two places to put it: called on shapes you hold, or set on a layer's source so every feature it hands out arrives in the map's system.

title: Measure in the Right Projection
description: Web Mercator is for looking at, not for measuring in: the same park measured on the ellipsoid, in an equal-area projection, in its state plane grid and in Web Mercator, at any latitude you drag it to.

title: Any Projection
description: The world in Robinson, Mollweide, Equal Earth and more on an OpenLayers map, warped in the browser or on the server.

title: Cross the Dateline
description: A great-circle route across the antimeridian, drawn whole on the globe and folded back into the world at the tile cut.

title: Adornments
description: Legend, scale line and bar, compass, logo and graticule drawn on the server and laid over the map; the compass turns with it.

title: Markers and Popups
description: Popups over Frisco's hotels read from a shapefile, and markers dropped where you click.

title: Geocoding
description: An address or place name goes to GeocodingCloudClient; every match comes back as a point with its bounds.

title: Reverse Geocoding
description: Click the map and ReverseGeocodingCloudClient answers with the nearest address and the places within a radius.

title: Routing
description: Stops go to RoutingCloudClient and the route comes back with turn-by-turn segments.

title: Service Area
description: How far 15 to 60 minutes of driving reach from a point, one polygon per limit.

title: Traveling Salesperson
description: Stops in any order go to the routing service, which answers with the shortest round trip.

title: Elevation
description: A point, line or area is sampled by ElevationCloudClient; a line's samples draw as a profile.

title: Time Zone
description: Click anywhere and TimeZoneCloudClient answers with the zone, the local time and the zone's outline.

title: Color Utilities
description: ColorCloudClient hands back a family of colours that go together; six of them class Frisco's block groups.

title: World Maps Query
description: The features behind ThinkGeo's world map found by a shape you draw, with MapsQueryCloudClient.

title: Export the Map
description: A picture of the map for a report or an email: at screen size the browser's own canvas, larger than that drawn again on the server, which needs no browser.

title: Print a Map
description: A zoning plan sheet laid out on the server: vector basemap, zoning, title block, legend, scale bar, north arrow, parcel table and notes placed in inches on the paper, exported as PDF.
